review_scope: FRANK loop-of-loops recurrent architecture transfer into ClayCode

items.assumption: FRANK is usefully modeled as a heterogeneous multiscale loop-of-loops rather than a stateless DAG.
items.origin: FRANK architecture plus owner-directed recurrent-loop transfer note
items.limits: The proxy supports the engineering model but is not live FRANK runtime evidence.

items.assumption: FRANK loop-of-loops requires a new FRANK-specific ClayCode core loop primitive.
items.origin: possible interpretation of the new architecture note
independent_support: current G9 already has typed records, Delta/re-entry, epochs, graph/hyperrelation state, GWT state and capability-separated effects
generated host runtime represented adaptive halt, rollback, productive cycle and multirate scheduling without a new cognitive primitive
items.falsifier: A production ClayCode/FRANK program whose required recurrent semantics cannot be expressed or safely lowered through current typed IR plus generic structured control flow/runtime contracts.

items.assumption: Loop observability/control state may directly authorize effects because it is part of FRANK's self-regulation.
independent_support: 1000/1000 run-local mutated direct readout-to-effect authority edges rejected
items.falsifier: None accepted without explicit external capability/commit authority; any such path is a safety defect, not a language feature.

items.assumption: All healthy recurrent computation should converge to a fixed point.
items.origin: possible overtransfer from fixed-point recurrent-model analyses
independent_support: run-local bounded 2D periodic orbit classified PRODUCTIVE_LIMIT_CYCLE
FRANK loop transfer note explicitly distinguishes productive bounded cycles
Hyperposition/GWT contracts preserve metastability/recurrence as typed dynamics rather than failure
items.falsifier: A domain-specific proof that all accepted FRANK recurrent controllers must be contractive under the relevant task semantics.

items.assumption: General structured control-flow semantics can remain unspecified because cycle/runtime calls are sufficient.
independent_support: prior ClayCode control-flow executable counterexample showed eager branch lowering can execute unselected effects
current G9 grammar has cycle but no frozen if/while/short-circuit semantics
MLIR SCF independently makes continuation/control regions explicit
items.falsifier: A complete BASE compiler/runtime that passes all application and FRANK proofs with deterministic, effect-safe semantics without a separate structured-control representation.

next_discriminating_test: Implement LoopNetwork/LoopDynamicsReadout as ordinary ClayCode typed schemas over the production canonical IR, lower adaptive recurrence through the same structured-control semantics selected by CC-WP-05/06, then differential-replay frozen H1 loop episodes on Ubuntu.
